content.text:
You can use the `esm_optimize` function to create a deployment template using SAM CLI. Here is an example of how you can do this:

```
esm_optimize action=generate_template esm_uuid=<ESM_UUID> event_source=<EVENT_SOURCE> project_name=<PROJECT_NAME> region=<REGION>
```

Replace `<ESM_UUID>` with the UUID of your ESM, `<EVENT_SOURCE>` with the type of event source you are using (e.g. "kafka", "kinesis", etc.), `<PROJECT_NAME>` with the name of your project, and `<REGION>` with the AWS region where your ESM is deployed.

This will generate a SAM template that you can use to deploy your ESM using SAM CLI.
